source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_voltage" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i voltage (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the voltage OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_voltage SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Retrieve platform voltage sensors over SNMPv3 and verify identities, engineering units and values against the expected operating range.
original_method: Engineer enables v3 and browses undefined `$target`; Criteria switch client but still omit sensors/values.
manual_activity: Engineer configures SNMPv3/WebUI; after a valid sensor contract, collection and numeric comparison are automated.
safety_requirements: Read only; never change power/voltage controls.
Protect v3 secrets; do not substitute v2c.
Reject unitless/unmapped values and preserve raw typed output.
Stop/escalate on unsafe voltage; no auto retry.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, query exact rails, convert documented scaling and compare to thresholds/reference telemetry.
Do not operate WebUI or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve rail map/ranges/state and configure/restore v3.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic OID plus grep cannot identify rails or units and uses wrong security mode.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor MIB-resolved voltage OIDs with documented units/scales and full responses.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Query the approved rail table under a fixed operating state, decode units/scaling and correlate with BMC/Redfish/IPMI sensor values and thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor voltage-sensor MIB and board limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds rail identity and quantitative acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents wrong-unit or wrong-rail false passes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Telemetry rounding and state-dependent rails require documented tolerance.

project_override_considerations: Project may define a board-specific rail subset, but must record omitted rails and exact state/tolerance.
expected_evidence: Raw typed values plus decoded volts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: IReasoning versus Net-SNMP methods are not reconciled, `$target` is undefined, and DeepSeek changes to v2c/generic subtree.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Rail mapping, scaling and limits are required project inputs. With manual SNMPv3 setup, the core query/comparison is automatable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Corrects BLOCKED to PACKAGE because owner-provided measurement metadata makes execution safe.

review_improvement: Defines quantitative rail-specific evidence and safety escalation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A raw value needs board scaling, but this is a supplied specification. Once available, software can compare every rail; attended setup makes the case PARTIAL.
